sourceOrigin: Latest V22 working-tree application snapshot, including Cash, OCR workflow, language switching and linked GL journal editing.

checks.build: passed; empty envDir and no VITE environment variables

notes: Full suite is not green. Known failures include pre-localization static UI assertions and incomplete test dependency mocks; these have not been hidden or counted as passing.
failures: editor separates immutable bank facts from editable matching data with an explicit non-algorithm preview
Bank status uses the shared portalled dropdown and the editor shows the same independent status
Bank toolbar uses the system plus action and opens the existing editor in create mode
statement action uses system design and opens a reviewable import, not IMPORTDATA history
tests/column-settings-groups.test.mjs
company chart shares the template title, back button, breadcrumbs and toolbar layout with Settings
account editor uses company-scoped cost center sources and keeps usage flags out of shared template editing
each company submenu opens, closes, and reopens without changing the active page
Payments navigation and New payment use a separate system screen with required controls
Save persists through the real local query contract and only changes the chosen company
tests/delete-buttons-lifecycle.test.mjs
both saved-document forms use the same read-only history, preserving form provenance during navigation
system menu trigger preserves the neutral action style and exposes expanded state to assistive technology
Actions opens a system confirmation for both imported documents and manual invoices
Document purpose offers only Purchase and Sale while preserving unchanged historical descriptions
card keeps Amount / Total Amount static and exposes the requested header controls
company document header omits Upload document without removing the existing import action
document information panel contains the upload guidance and the existing Dashboard ADDINFO shortcut
list separates selected-document transfer from file export and refreshes scope and rights at action time
export retains the centered system-choice dialog and existing down-arrow design; import still opens uploads
Reported issue is a plain description; document links and View open the document directly
system table controls and explicit issue-aware editing retain permission and accounting guards
queued corrections do not appear as ready-to-approve OCR documents
list, status filter, create and copy use shared processing states without changing historical data
list and Actions menu open the shared confirmation; Cancel does not run deletion
create and rename persist stable Type codes and dropdown labels while retaining legacy company choices
inactive types are omitted, cannot be recreated through +, and reappear after activation
duplicate, empty, invalid and stale catalog edits are rejected without mutating data
status migration preserves legacy edits and custom rows while adding missing workflow values
status names are presentation only: renaming Approved cannot remove its workflow meaning
a configured custom status saves into invoices and edits, and fresh deactivation prevents a new assignment
malformed catalogs fail closed and cannot be overwritten by settings saves
journal toolbar keeps column grouping while removing the requested controls
VAT closing is period-only; email controls belong to the separate reconciliation action
GL account bulk selection is opt-in, respects search and does not close the menu
credit selector uses the system dropdown, company-scoped load, and appears only for credit invoices
rendered totals contain one main summary and only a foreign-currency extra total
additional and attachments start collapsed, with one notes field, sales-only fields and preview controls
Invoice lines uses one editable table without Summary / Quantity switches and keeps existing controls
Split uses a compact aligned table with a fixed allocation column for any number of lines
Documents row and both editor Actions route credit notes directly to the shared invoice form
invoice header has a system status dropdown and save label follows the selected status
Invoices owns creation UI; the shared Documents register retains classification and access filtering
Create invoice uses the shared system Back button and preserves save-time disabling
Accounting defaults starts expanded and contains only the four requested system fields
the notifications bell is absent from every OCR area but retained outside OCR
notification chat opens inside the normal shell and Back retains the notification subtree and scroll
explicit Chats sidebar navigation exits the notification detour and opens the normal Chats view
opening a chat document and returning preserves the chat and its notification return path
opening a related chat still rechecks current chat access before navigating
tests/notification-details-panel.test.mjs
document type settings expose routing and completion validates before either destination
only Approve documents opts into shared delivery with system buttons and the same dialog
reported issues have a separate Workspace route and system breadcrumb, not an approval panel
legacy Workspace navigation resolves to an accessible child and never opens a separate parent page
Workspace uses the system connector between visible submenu items without dangling lines
read-only workflow reuses document extraction layout and guards writes and work-time logging
competing values are attached to their own learning record with supplier and field context
help is an icon-only Dashboard-style popup and the worker queue shortcut is removed
actual example adapter is repeat-safe across concurrent loads, reloads, edits and deletions
Processing documents is consistent in OCR navigation and heading
only enabled mandatory fields block approval; empty yellow and green remain optional
tests/reconciliation-gl-dialog.test.mjs
linked rows label each document side without inventing GL account codes
Document received opens the shared Reconcile form without saving; Cancel preserves Missing document
confirm receives and reconciles in one write and closes the shared form
an external storage change blocks confirmation without receiving or overwriting records
Document received respects company edit permission
tests/related-object-link.test.mjs
Reconciliation and all shared tables use one lifecycle, button and fullscreen sizing

checks.browser: Published startup, asset hashes and source archive will be verified after deployment; not a complete UI regression test.

limitations: Frontend demonstration only; no secure backend authentication or shared production database.
Bank connection, payment sending, accounting transfer, OCR and email APIs are not connected.
Local .env, shared-data files, credentials and node_modules are excluded.
Pages versions on the same domain may share browser storage; use a separate browser profile for isolated testing.
